name: Tommy Wisdom
features: fair skin, dark hair parted at the side, lively eyes, round genial face, medium build, amused talkative expression
bio: Motoring correspondent of the Daily Herald, and a driver who made the journalism pay for the racing: fifty-two sports car races over thirty-three years and twenty-three Monte Carlo rallies. In 1936 he won the Alpine Trial outright in an SS Jaguar 100 with his wife Elsie beside him, beating the Bugattis and putting the young marque on the map abroad. His wife raced as ‘Bill’ Wisdom and his daughter Ann rallied with Pat Moss.
